name: Apply Window Finish Coat
intent: One coat of finish per module invocation. Brush or spray gated by application method. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with MOD_INTERSTAGE_WINDOW between them.
doctrine: Brush finish (3.5 → 4 win/hr) is the slow detail-oriented method. Window brush rate is significantly slower than door brush (4 sides/hr per door = 2 doors/hr) because windows have more cut-ins per opening (sash, mullion, sill, jamb, casing intersection). Spray (8 → 10 win/hr) is 2.3x faster. Per-window-type complexity (TDL muntins, fixed vs operable, large vs small) gets handled by the existing engine's WINDOW_TYPE_MODIFIERS table at the per-item compute layer (deferred to Phase 1c).
